name: triage-webapp

dependencies.name: ticket-api
dependencies.description: Lists and filters the ticket queue, loads ticket detail and history, and submits urgency overrides, draft edits, approvals and rejections.

description: The Support Agent console: a shared queue of incoming tickets with their AI-assigned urgency and drafted reply, a detail view to edit the draft or override urgency, and approve/reject actions. Holds no data of its own — every read and write goes through ticket-api.
